readme: Food macro database for Thrifty Crew meal prep. Each item's calories/protein_g/carbs_g/fat_g are PER SERVING. serving_grams = grams in one serving (used to scale by weight, e.g. pounds). For count or volume items (eggs, tbsp), serving_qty + serving_unit describe the serving. Conversions: 1 lb = 453.592 g, 1 oz = 28.3495 g. Note raw vs cooked for meats. brand empty string = not specified yet. null macro = pending label.

Long Grain White Rice; 1/4 cup (45g) dry per serving; from label. RE-POINTED 2026-08-07: this row was a Member's Mark THAI JASMINE label (1/4 cup = 50 g, 180 cal), which put it at 200 g per cup while db\densities.json said 185 and the board priced long grain. The board's White Rice commodity is long grain at all seven stores, so the cost math was already long-grain and this row was the odd one out. Mahatma Extra Long Grain states the same 45 g / 160 cal serving, so the figure is not one bag's quirk. Per gram this moved calories 3.60 -> 3.56 and protein 0.080 -> 0.067: at most 5.3 cal and 1.6 g protein per serving across the 305 recipes that use rice.
